name: norm_map_coord_zero
statement: MultilinearMap 𝕜 E G) (hf : Continuous f) {m : ∀ i, E i} {i : ι} (hi : ‖m i‖ = 0) : ‖f m‖ = 0

name: bound_of_shell_of_norm_map_coord_zero
statement: MultilinearMap 𝕜 E G) (hf₀ : ∀ {m i}, ‖m i‖ = 0 → ‖f m‖ = 0) {ε : ι → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hε : ∀ i, 0 < ε i) {c : ι → 𝕜} (hc : ∀ i, 1 < ‖c i‖) (hf : ∀ m : ∀ i, E i, (∀ i, ε i / ‖c i‖ ≤ ‖m i‖) → (∀ i, ‖m i‖ < ε i) → ‖f m‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, ‖m i‖) (m : ∀ i, E i) : ‖f m‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, ‖m i‖

name: exists_bound_of_continuous
statement: MultilinearMap 𝕜 E G) (hf : Continuous f) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ m, ‖f m‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, ‖m i‖

name: continuous_of_bound
statement: MultilinearMap 𝕜 E G) (C : ℝ) (H : ∀ m, ‖f m‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, ‖m i‖) : Continuous f

name: uniformity_eq_seminorm
statement: 𝓤 (ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 E G) = ⨅ r > 0, 𝓟 {f | ‖-f.1 + f.2‖ < r}

name: iteratedFDerivComponent
statement: Type*} [Fintype α] (f : ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 E₁ G) {s : Set ι} (e : α ≃ s) [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] : ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 (fun (i : {a : ι // a ∉ s}) ↦ E₁ i) (ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 (fun (_ : α) ↦ (∀ i, E₁ i)) G)

have_tree.type: ∀ x, x ∈ s.toFinsetᶜ ↔ (fun x ↦ x ∉ s) x
